sourceFile: 30. TIU L5S3-01 R Report test Dry final sample and wait dry 12h to check function 2025.12.16_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not approved because the changed-factor and outcome grouping do not match the cited validation context.
issues: Changed factor mixes treatment, timepoints, defect columns, and totals.
Baseline/test conditions omit Type 2 and unsupported normal comparator.
Before vs later OK-only retests are not comparable as simple improvement pairs.
Measurement outcome appears derived from count columns, not measurement data.
Evidence set misses key Type 2 and later result rows.
requiredUserQuestions: Should normal comparison be included only if normal result rows exist in the sheet?
correctionPlan: Regroup primary factor as Type 1 dry oven treatment vs Type 2 wait 12h, with normal only if cited.
Keep before/after days as timepoint subgroup context, not changed conditions.
Recalculate NG outcomes within comparable populations and timepoints.
Remove measurement statistics unless real measurement/spec rows are present.
Cite purpose/content, header, and all relevant Type 1 and Type 2 result rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are row-valid but insufficient and partly misapplied for final evidence.
